name: Ilia Topuria
photo_coverage: Good. Front: 2024 Georgian presidential ceremony (CC BY), June 2026 weigh-in (PD) and the ESPN studio headshot. Right-side profile: June 2026 weigh-in interview (PD, small in frame) and a soft 2022 video still. Physique: June 2026 weigh-in plus two ESPN full-body cutouts. Recent: four photos from June 2026.

face.shape: Oval-to-rectangular and fairly long. Widest at the cheekbones, with straight sides that run down into a squared jaw under the beard. The face reads lean, not wide.
face.jaw: Well defined and moderately wide, with clear jaw angles below the ears. The beard follows and sharpens the jaw line (trimmed neckline).
face.chin: Medium width, slightly squared, hidden under the beard. In the right profile (2026 interview) it sits roughly in line with the lower lip.
face.cheekbones: Moderately prominent and high; the cheeks below are flat to slightly hollow at fight weight (2026 weigh-in), a little fuller in March 2024.
face.brow_ridge: Moderately strong. The brows sit low on it, so the eyes look slightly deep-set, especially under stage light.
face.forehead: Medium height, fairly broad, smooth with faint horizontal lines. Fully exposed by the slicked-back 2026 hair.

eyes.shape: Almond, with slightly heavy upper lids and outer corners that sit level to slightly down, giving a calm, slightly sleepy look. Mild under-eye shadows.
eyes.colour: Medium-to-dark brown in every photo. Closest embed iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Low and fairly straight with a soft angle about two-thirds out; the tails drop slightly. Groomed, with a clean gap between the brows.
eyebrows.colour: Very dark brown to black, a touch darker than the head hair.

nose.width: Medium; the nostrils are a little wider than the bridge suggests.
nose.bridge: Straight and medium-narrow from the front.
nose.hump: None visible; the profile is straight (2026 interview, 2022 still).
nose.tip: Rounded and slightly full, pointing a little downward.
nose.fight_damage: No obvious breaks or flattening in these photos.

face.mouth_lips: Medium width. Thin upper lip mostly hidden by the moustache; fuller lower lip. Resting expression closed and neutral; often a slight pressed-lip set (2026 weigh-in).

ears.protrusion: Slightly out from the head; easy to see because the sides are faded to skin.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Possibly mild on the left ear: the upper part looks a little thick and smooth in the 2024 ceremony photo and the studio headshot. The right ear looks normal in the 2026 weigh-in. Not severe; model normal ears with slightly thick rims.

hair.style: High skin fade on the sides and back. In June 2026 the top is grown out and combed straight back with a soft side part and some volume at the front (slick-back, styled with product). In March 2024 the top was a shorter textured crop.
hair.colour: Very dark brown, near black. Under stage light the slicked top shows blue-grey highlights, which are reflections, not grey hair.
hair.hairline: Straight across with slightly squared corners and mild recession at the temples; dense on top.

facial_hair.colour: Very dark brown, the same as the hair; warmer brown in the wood-panelled 2024 room.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin, moustache and jaw; slightly lighter on the upper cheeks.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 8-12 mm on the chin, about 5 mm on the cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Full short beard joined to the moustache, carefully groomed: a crisp, fairly high cheek line, a sharp line along the jaw to the neck, and the neck shaved below the jaw. Same style in 2024 and 2026.

tone_samples.light: indoor, strong orange bounce from wood panelling

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on well-lit skin (box in source pixels). Studio (ESPN/UFC) cutouts are high-key and warm-graded, so they read lighter and pinker than arena or daylight photos; the average mixes lighting on purpose.
skin.undertone: Warm, light olive. Tans to a golden-beige; no strong pink flush.
skin.freckles_marks: Smooth skin, no freckles visible. Dark body hair is minimal on the chest (mostly covered by tattoos).

body.build: Compact and very muscular for his height (170 cm); dense, heavy upper body. Looks like a strong featherweight/lightweight rather than a rangy one. Reach (175 cm) is 5 cm longer than his height.
body.body_fat_notes: Low body fat at fight week (June 2026): clear six-pack and obliques, visible veins on the forearms.
body.shoulders: Broad and round with big deltoids; traps moderately developed.
body.chest: Thick, full pecs (the tiger tattoos sit on a well-developed chest).
body.arms: Large biceps and triceps for the weight class, thick forearms.
body.waist: Narrow relative to the shoulders; a pronounced V-taper.
body.legs_calves: Muscular thighs with clear quad definition; solid calves. Legs are of average length for his height.
body.neck: Thick and muscular, nearly as wide as the jaw from the front.
body.posture: Upright, chest out, chin level to slightly down; holds his hands high in a tight orthodox guard (weigh-in pose).
body.notable_physique_traits: Short, powerful frame with a big chest and shoulders, tight waist and heavily tattooed chest and left arm. Should look stocky-muscular next to taller lightweights.

tattoos.where: Chest, both pecs, running up over both shoulders
tattoos.description: Large black-and-grey piece: two roaring tiger heads (one on each pec, facing the centre) framed by pine-forest silhouettes that climb onto both shoulders; a small orange/red accent near the left nipple.
tattoos.size: About 40 cm wide x 25 cm tall

tattoos.where: Upper sternum / base of the throat, between the collarbones
tattoos.description: Crown above a capital 'T' inside a hexagonal frame, with small wings either side. Visible above an open shirt collar too.

tattoos.where: Left arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist, continuing onto the back of the left hand
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey sleeve with colour accents: classical columns/arches and a helmeted warrior on the shoulder; red block lettering beginning 'HASTA' on the upper arm (rest not legible); a wolf head; a small 'K' with a heart near the elbow; clock faces, roses and a woman's portrait on the forearm.

tattoos.where: Left side of the lower ribcage, below the left pec
tattoos.description: 'El Matador' in cursive script. Visible at the June 2026 weigh-in but not in the older ESPN studio cutout, so it is a newer tattoo.
tattoos.size: About 12 cm wide x 3 cm tall

tattoos.description: No sleeve. Only the top of the right shoulder carries the edge of the chest piece (pine trees); the right upper arm and forearm look clear from the front.

accessories_seen: Gold chain with a cross pendant and a medallion (weigh-in), large gold or steel watch, string bracelets on the left wrist.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC-issued fight shorts. ESPN cutout 1: red shorts with a darker red geometric print, white chevron stripes on both legs and a black waistband with a red UFC tab. ESPN cutout 2 (probably the June 2026 Freedom 250 kit): navy shorts with red and white curved stripes on his right leg, a white UFC wordmark, crypto.com logo; red gloves with US-flag cuffs. June 2026 weigh-in: navy track shorts with a red drawstring and a small white UFC logo.
kit.walkout: June 2026: navy zip jacket and track pants with a red-and-white stripe panel (UFC/Venum styling), white-and-navy trainers, red gloves.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets; estimates for standard MakeHuman ear modifiers if they are added.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, skin, tattoos and build; medium-high for face proportions (two sharp frontal photos plus a studio headshot); medium for exact morph values. 8 photos: 5 Commons (CC BY / PD), 3 ESPN reference-only; 4 are from June 2026. The profile views are weak (one small in frame, one blurry video still), so nose depth and chin projection are estimates. What to watch: (1) The look depends on the groomed short dark beard with a crisp cheek line plus the high skin fade; in 2026 the top is long and slicked back, so short02/short04 alone will look too short on top. (2) Keep the brows thick, dark and low, close to the eyes. (3) The chest tattoo (two tigers + pines) and the crown-T at the throat are the strongest body cues; the sleeve is on HIS LEFT arm and the right arm is bare; 'El Matador' is on his left ribs (mirror-check: viewer's right when he faces camera). (4) Body: short (scale to 170.2 cm), very muscular, big chest and deltoids, tight waist; do not make him lanky. (5) Skin is warm light olive; avoid pink. Macro ageOldM uses (years-25)/65 like src/avatar3d.js. l-/r- morphs refer to the character's own left/right; values are symmetric.

stance.source: Set 2026-11-06 from his documented fighting style: data/scouting/ilia-topuria.json (archetype, tags, signature and summary) and widely described stance traits. The ESPN stance cutouts (espn-stance-left.png, espn-stance-right.png) are posed standing shots, so they were used only for posture, shoulder set and build, not for the guard or footwork; fight footage would sharpen these values.
stance.notes: Pressure boxer: tight high guard, chin down, head moving off the centre line as he walks the opponent to the fence.
